abort.already_configured: This Declan server is already configured.

data.category_fallback: Use a saved equivalent reply when the provider fails
data.primary_daily_character_limit: Daily primary character limit (UTC; 0 means unlimited)
data.openai_stt_auto_vocabulary: Use my Home Assistant names as vocabulary

data_description.openai_stt_api_key: Leave blank to keep the existing key. Required when enabling transcription for the first time.
data_description.local_stt_entity: Optional local stt.* entity. Leave blank to use the configured Wyoming speaker bridge.
data_description.local_tts: Optional local tts.* entity, such as tts.piper. Used only after the primary provider and saved equivalent replies fail. Leave blank for no local fallback.
data_description.openai_stt_vocabulary: Up to 12 comma-separated names or words that speech-to-text often gets wrong, such as Braai or Study.
data_description.openai_stt_auto_vocabulary: Also send your Home Assistant room names and the names of devices shared with Assist (plus Howzit Declan), so names are misheard less. These names go to OpenAI with each request. Refreshed every 10 minutes.

error.openai_key_required: Enter an OpenAI API key to enable transcription.
error.wyoming_host_required: Enter the VoicePipeline host to enable Wyoming recognition.
error.invalid_tts_provider: Enter the entity ID of your speech provider, such as tts.elevenlabs_text_to_speech.
error.invalid_stt_provider: Enter a valid local speech entity ID, such as stt.faster_whisper.
error.invalid_local_tts: Enter a local speech entity ID such as tts.piper. It must differ from the primary provider and must not be the Declan Voice Manager.
